name: Rent-a-Cop
qaNote: Reference inspected. Preserve heavyset build, mustache, black cap, white security shirt, black harness/tie/trousers, radio and keys. Existing costume logos stay physical details; no added fist effects. Check belt/cage continuity, readable five-second action, stable badges and keying around white shirt.
choreography:
IDENTITY: exact heavyset adult security guard from the reference, curly brown hair under black cap, thick mustache, white short-sleeve shirt, black tie and tactical harness, black trousers, chunky dark sneakers, walkie-talkie, belt equipment and dangling keys. Keep the existing small costume markings. No new weapon.
0–0.7s: full-body guard throws his open left palm toward camera in an exaggerated STOP gesture and clicks the radio in his right hand once. His mustache bristles with completely unjustified authority. Behind the palm, one runaway empty chrome shopping cart rockets toward him through empty cyan, wheels spinning.
0.7–2.5s: camera whip-pans and pulls back to reveal his absurd response: four enormous portable chrome queue posts snap into position around the cart. Wide red retractable belts shoot between them, crossing over and under into a huge suspended web. The cart hits the web with one gigantic bounded ivory/red impact burst, stretching it twenty feet into a deep elastic pocket. He remains upright at the origin, whole body visible, smug and motionless. This is one clear trap-and-rebound action; no mall scenery, floor, background panel or people in the cart.
2.5–3.5s: the belts recoil in a thunderous SNAP, wrapping neatly around the empty cart into an overbuilt rectangular parcel. Camera slams back to his stern face as the exact title MALL RULES stamps into the lower composition with a metal-and-rubber impact. Do not add stop signs or other new writing.
3.5–5s: complete guard and securely wrapped cart framed together on cyan. He gravely sticks one tiny BLANK warning slip onto the enormous bundled cart, then gives it a disapproving wag of one finger. The cart's single loose wheel spins and squeaks. SFX: radio click/chirp with no voice, wheel rattle, accelerating retractable-belt whips, enormous elastic catch and snap, title slam, tiny paper pat and squeaky wheel. Five-second choreography, no sped-up footage.

name: Revolutionary Ronald
qaNote: Reference inspected. Preserve locs, beard, red beret with existing star, olive fatigues, satchel and red/black/green cape. No new emblems. Review cape continuity during rescue, clear protection before deflection, readable secondary training figure and green fabric retained in chroma key.
choreography:
IDENTITY: exact adult dark-skinned man with long dark locs, full short beard, red beret with its small existing star, olive fatigues with rolled sleeves, tan cross-body pouch and combat boots. His huge red/black/green striped cloth cape is the central prop, with its original colors and ragged hem. The cape must remain fabric attached at his shoulders, not a background or a new creature.
0–1.2s: whole-body heroic low angle. He notices a small faceless orange padded training mannequin tumbling far away through cyan; three heavy black iron spheres are converging toward it from above. He throws his arm outward and the cape snaps taut behind him with an enormous cloth crack. All targets are nonliving training props.
1.2–3.2s: camera races down the cape as it unfurls into a spectacular thirty-foot-long ribbon, twisting through depth like an aerial rescue line. Its far end scoops the orange mannequin into a soft cloth cradle just before the spheres meet. A hard yank draws the cradle all the way back toward his side in one continuous wave along the fabric. Keep cyan visible around every fabric edge and between the separated spheres, never fill the frame with the cape.
3.2–4.8s: dynamic half-orbit around him as he pivots, tucking the rescued mannequin behind his shoulder and sweeping the broad middle of his cape outward into a huge curved protective sail. The three iron spheres strike the stretched fabric in quick succession; it bows deeply, then he reverses the sweep and slings ALL THREE back into the distant cyan in one colossal simultaneous recoil. Bounded ivory/red impact stars at the three contacts, a dramatic cloth ripple visible from shoulder to hem. His face and body stay solid and recognizable.
4.8–6s: cape snaps back to its normal wearable size. He raises his actual hand in the same resolute pose as the reference while the exact title WE OUTSIDE. slams below his face, including the final period. No extra slogans, chants, fist emblems or crowd.
6–8s: full-body hero hold, rescued orange mannequin safely upright beside his boot, cape fluttering in three beautiful separated folds. A tiny crease remains in his beret; he fixes it with two precise fingers without breaking his stern stare. SFX: massive cloth unfurl, accelerating rescue whoosh, three heavy bass impacts, dominant sail recoil crack, three receding whistles, title slam and soft beret pat. No music, speech or narration.

name: Roommate
qaNote: Reference inspected. Preserve messy locks, goatee, stained white shirt, draped laundry, black shorts, mismatched socks/slides, controller and dishes. Review food-prop continuity, no new printed labels, readable title across two lines, and cyan controller light/keying. Keep the room absent.
choreography:
IDENTITY: exact lanky adult man with messy short twisting dark locks, small goatee, lazy half-lidded expression, stained oversized white T-shirt, black athletic shorts with white trim, mismatched socks and striped slides, laundry draped over one shoulder and leg. Preserve the black game controller in his right hand and the precarious takeaway bowl/boxes held in his left arm.
0–0.7s: establish complete slouching character. He presses one controller button without looking up. A closed ivory double-door refrigerator floats behind him on pure cyan, no kitchen or floor. Its doors bulge outward as if something enormous is packed inside.
0.7–2.5s: the doors burst open and a colossal avalanche of takeaway boxes, noodle ribbons and plastic leftovers containers curls out like a cresting wave. Camera rockets backward to show its ridiculous scale, several times his height. He casually hops onto one broad container lid at the wave's leading edge and surfs the curling airborne food spiral toward camera, controller still in his right hand, bowl balanced in his left. His laziness contrasts with the huge fast action. Rich orange noodles, ivory boxes and brown sauce, never blue-green vapor. The fridge is one finite prop with dark interior visible only inside its silhouette.
2.5–3.5s: one final controller click SLAMS the refrigerator doors. The airborne food wave recoils in a tight spectacular spiral back through a shrinking gap, leaving only him, his lid and the bowl. One giant bounded cream/orange impact burst on the door slam. Exact title YOUR SIDE OF THE FRIDGE slams in two stable readable lines beneath his face. No new labels, usernames or receipts with writing.
3.5–5s: settle into a whole-character pose beside the closed fridge, controller lowered and his original dishes/laundry still carried. He plucks one long noodle from the bowl and slurps it with a deeply unbothered expression. One lonely sock slowly slides down the refrigerator handle. SFX: two crisp controller clicks, overstuffed door creak, enormous tumbling-box rumble and spiral whoosh, dominant fridge-door BOOM, title slam, short noodle slurp. No words, music, scenery or full-frame smoke. Distinct action beats authored for five seconds.

name: Seafood Assassin
qaNote: Reference inspected. Preserve brown skin, high ponytail, white headband and fitted white tactical suit, black gloves/belt/holster/boots and transparent seafood-boil bag. Review clear sauce color as food, finite cyclone, three separate ignition beats, bag transparency over cyan and intact face/costume.
choreography:
IDENTITY: exact adult brown-skinned woman from the reference, focused face, long dark high ponytail, wide white headband, white zipped tactical jumpsuit, black gloves, belt, thigh straps and tall black boots. She carries the clear seafood-boil bag with orange shellfish, yellow corn, clams and butter, tied with a red clip. The sauce is obviously thick orange-red seasoned food, not blood. Preserve her illustrated style and original proportions.
0–1.2s: full-body fighter establishment. She flips the bag once and catches its tied end between two gloved fingers. Snap close-up: a single heavy drop of orange garlic sauce hangs beneath the bag and quivers as she cocks an eyebrow. She lashes the bag around her body in one fast low-to-high arc.
1.2–3.2s: camera pulls upward and away to reveal that arc unfolding into a towering corkscrew of glossy sauce, cooked crab claws, corn sections and shellfish shells. She vaults through the OPEN CENTER of the huge spiral, ponytail trailing, body fully readable against cyan. Three large iron serving cloches hover in a triangular formation below. Three thick sauce lashes peel out of the spiral and strike the three cloches in distinct, precise contacts, each leaving a bright orange food coating. No people or animals struck, all shellfish visibly cooked food.
3.2–4.8s: she lands in an airborne graphic crouch at the center, flicks one tiny butter cube upward and catches it back in the bag. On that tiny gesture all THREE coated cloches ignite in quick rhythmic succession, then leap outward on a single huge synchronized explosion of bounded orange flame petals, ivory impact stars and disconnected sizzling droplets. The payoff looks like an ultimate culinary super attack. Cyan remains visible around and between the separate blasts; no full-screen sauce sheet, smoke cloud or white flash.
4.8–6s: whip close-up to her face while she catches the refilled boil bag on one shoulder. Exact title EXTRA SAUCE slams along the lower frame with a wet-heavy impact and sizzling tail. Keep her face and white headband completely clear.
6–8s: return to a complete cool hero stance. One final cooked shrimp drops from above; she catches it cleanly with two fingers, tilts her head in satisfaction, and drops it back into the bag. Her white suit is still spotless. SFX: bag/plastic crackle, heavy sauce whip, accelerating spiral roar, three precise wet impacts, three sharp ignitions into one dominant culinary BOOM, title slam, trailing sizzle and tiny shrimp plop. No dialogue, music or narration.
